status.label: Not ready: 1 fatal error in the logs

summary: The code scanner finds almost nothing here: the values come from database rows. The error logs of a run on PHP 8.5.12 show what it cannot see: a TypeError that stops the request in Report::show(), NULL passed to json_decode() and strtolower(), and two deprecations the scanner also reported. Entries in system/ and vendor/ belong to the framework and a package.

notes.title: Report::show() stops with a TypeError when status is an array
notes.body: The Laravel log has "strtolower(): Argument #1 ($string) must be of type string, array given" at app/Http/Controllers/Report.php:8. PHP 7 only warned and returned NULL; since PHP 8.0 a wrongly typed argument to a built-in throws, so the request fails. The same line also gets NULL (2 deprecations in the log) and a missing key (warning). Accept only strings.

proof.run: is_string($row['status'] ?? null) ? strtolower($row['status']) : '' for 'PAID', NULL, ['x'] and a missing key
proof.output: 'paid', '', '', '' with no warning, deprecation or TypeError

evidence.title: RFC: Consistent type errors for internal functions (PHP 8.0)
evidence.quote: This RFC proposes to consistently generate TypeError exceptions for all invalid parameter types, regardless of whether the function is user-defined or extension-defined.

evidence.title: PHP 8.1 UPGRADING (php-src)
evidence.quote: Passing null to a non-nullable argument of a built-in function is deprecated.

notes.title: json_decode() receives NULL from the settings column (only in the logs)
notes.body: The CodeIgniter log has the deprecation twice at application/libraries/Local.php:7; the scanner does not report it because the value comes from a database row. A default of '' keeps today's result exactly (NULL, with json_last_error() 4) without the deprecation, which becomes a TypeError in PHP 9.

proof.run: json_decode($row['settings'] ?? '', true) for a NULL, a JSON string and a missing column; json_decode(null, true) as the baseline
proof.output: NULL / ['a' => 1] / NULL, json_last_error() 4 for '' as for null; only the baseline prints "json_decode(): Passing null to parameter #1 ($json) of type string is deprecated"

evidence.title: PHP 8.1 UPGRADING (php-src)
evidence.quote: Passing null to a non-nullable argument of a built-in function is deprecated.

notes.title: Entries in system/ and vendor/ are not this app's code
notes.body: system/core/Loader.php (each() was removed in PHP 8.0) and system/core/Input.php belong to the CodeIgniter system folder; vendor/acme/lib to a package. They are fixed by upgrading the framework or the package, not in the app. Check that the log really came from PHP 8.5.12: logs of the old PHP cannot contain the new deprecations.
